impact: A soft reception would weigh on AI sentiment (GOOGL and AMZN are investors); a strong one supports the AI infrastructure trade including NBIS.
summary: Anthropic's roadshow is reported to run the week of Nov 9, targeting a listing the week of Nov 16, but the latest S-1/A (Nov 2) has no price range. Reported valuation talk is $1.25T to $1.75T, with investors expecting roughly $1.3T to $1.5T.
title: Anthropic IPO roadshow week starts with no price range filed
